svg.title: HuntWick identity comparison

g.text: The grip joins a lens at the left cap to the crossbar.
A rising cut in the i stem follows the grip.
Two folded rails meet at a shared central lens.
An oblique stem and flat grip echo the split rails.
The heavy waist carries a magnifier cut in reverse.
A dark-ring dot repeats the reverse lens.
A continuous round stroke returns through the lower left lens.
The dot turns upward on the same rounded grip.
A wedge-shaped right shoulder nests under a floating lens.
The tapered stem carries a short independent grip.
Bracketed feet and an inset lower lens form a slab-serif H.
A small foot grounds the i under its ring and grip.

svg.text: Choose an app icon and a wordmark independently.
Standalone artwork, transparent vectors and native-size pixel samples accompany each study.
